findings.claim: The watch-specific retention setting still reconfigures the full Iggy broker even when CDC and the v2 watch service are disabled.
findings.evidence: `build_broker` unconditionally passes `config.entity_watch_retention_seconds` into `ConfiguredLogBroker::for_full`, while `GatewayConfig::validate` only enforces the >=86400 watch-retention invariant inside `if self.cdc_enabled` in `crates/frf-gateway/src/config/validation.rs`; the prior resolution states that when CDC is off the runtime should disable v2 watch and omit that service.
findings.suggested_fix: Either validate `ENTITY_WATCH_RETENTION_SECONDS` unconditionally because it is used as broker replay retention, or only pass/apply this watch-specific retention when CDC/v2 watch is enabled and keep the default broker replay retention otherwise.
